projectTitle: Choosroozy: A decision you can drag
project_haiku: Choosroozy puts two options on a canvas and lets you drag the reasons until the choice is visible. It is a small JavaScript tool for a decision that was previously all in your head.
project_footer_CTA: Want a small interface that makes an abstract choice concrete? Choosroozy is that kind of sketch, built and usable.
pageSummary:
The job

Most decisions stay invisible. You hold two options and a pile of reasons, and the loudest reason wins. Choosroozy is a sketch of the other way: put the options on screen and move the reasons by hand.

What we built

Two choices sit on a canvas, "go for a run" against "take a nap," or any pair you type. Each factor is a circle. Drag it left or right to take a side. Drag it up or down to change its weight. Color shows which option the factor supports, and a mixed color shows a factor that pulls both ways.

The sketch is in p5.js and runs in the browser. You can try it from the project link.

Outcomes

The decision is a picture you can edit. That is the whole product, and it is enough to show how a small interface can carry a real task.
